entities.summary: Seliger is a lake in Ostashkovsky District of Tver Oblast and in Demyansky District of Novgorod Oblast of Russia, in the northwest of the Valdai Hills, a part of the Volga basin. It has an absolute height of 205 metres (673 ft), an area of 212 square kilometres (82 mi2), and an average depth of 5.8 metres (19 ft).
